name: Sparsity Regularization for Pruning
definition: A regularization term applied to learnable mask parameters m_j to guide pruning and encourage condensed representations by promoting both fine-grained sparsity and structural coherence (removing entire anchors).
summary: Sparsity Regularization for Pruning uses group L2 norms to cohesively deactivate entire anchors in 3D Gaussian Splatting, ensuring structural coherence unlike standard L1 penalties.
